default.intent: Clown juggling frame with readable costume, hands, balls, and final accents
mustReadAs: clown face, hat, bow tie, hands, arms, pants, legs, shoes, and juggling balls read without the source image
baggy yellow pants read as clothing with two trouser lobes, seams, cuffs, and attached shoes, not as a ball or skirt
juggling balls are separate props with no long visible connector lines, guide paths, panel marks, or accidental strings

regions.name: face-hat-bow
regions.expect: face, hat, hair, nose, mouth, and bow tie are attached and readable

regions.name: hands-arms-body
regions.expect: hands connect through wrists, sleeves, elbows, and shoulders

regions.name: pants-legs-shoes
regions.expect: baggy pants show waistband, separate trouser lobes, seams, cuffs, visible leg exits, and attached shoes

regions.name: balls-and-motion-accents
regions.expect: red, blue, and yellow balls read as balls; any motion accents are short/local and not connector lines
